title: Isivumelwano 'to be' (am/is/are)
bridge: NgisiZulu sinomthetho omibili: 'nging' ne 'ngikwazi'. NgisiNgisi kunye isivumelwano esisodwa: 'to be'. Indaba enhle yikuthi ngesiZulu futhi siyasebenza 'nging/ngikwazi' ukubhala izinhloso nezimo, njengenkathi ngisiNgisi. Isahluko esibalulekile yikuthi ngisiNgisi AKUYI ukushiya umphathi: uyadinga 'I am', 'you are', 'he is', njalo.
rule: Isivumelwano 'to be' ngesikhathi samanje sinezindo ezintathu: 'am' (ukuba 'I'), 'is' (ukuba 'he, she, it') ne 'are' (ukuba 'you, we, they'). Ukubhala imibuzo, isipheqo siyafakaliswa: 'Are you...?', 'Is he...?'. Ukubhala ukungavumi, siyengeza 'not': 'I am not', 'he is not' (okanye 'he isn't'), 'they are not' (okanye 'they aren't').

common_error.explanation: NgesiZulu sisho 'Ngihlupa' ngaphandle kwesivumelwano esisodwa, kodwa ngisiNgisi isivumelwano 'to be' siyadingeka. Ungashiyi 'am/is/are'.

title: Izibambo Ezindabenza (Mina, wena, yena, thina, nina, bona)
bridge: Ngesi, izibambo ezindabenza zifana: mina, wena, yena, thina, nina, bona. Isahluko esikhulu ngokuthi ngesi siyasetshenzisa isibambo njengendaba ngisho nalapho isiHpanishi siyayekayo: 'I am tired' (hhayi kuphela 'am tired'). Nalo ukuthi uqaphele ukucandeza 'he' no 'she' — ngesi zicela ukudla kwesilisa, hhayi ukudla kwesibambo njengesiHpanishi.
rule: Izibambo ezindabenza ngesi ziyo: I (mina), you (wena/nina), he (yena indoda), she (yena umsiti), it (into), we (thina), they (bona). 'It' setIsetshenziswa izinto, izilwane, nezindaba. 'You' singxenye esisodwa nangxenye elinganiselwe. Akukho isibambo esiyekayo njengendaba ngesi.

common_error.correct: He is a teacher. / She is a teacher.
common_error.explanation: NgesiHpanishi sithi 'Es profesor' siyayekayo isibambo, kodwa ngesi isibambo singqikayo. Ngisho nalapho ufanele uthi 'He is...' okanye 'She is...'.

title: Izincazelo (a/an, the)
bridge: Ngesi sinothile izincazelo: 'a/an' (indefinite) no 'the' (definite). Isahluko esibalulekile ngisho futhi ukuthi nge-English asebenzisi 'the' ngezindaba eziphambili (sithi 'Life is beautiful', hhayi 'The life is beautiful'). Khumbula futhi ukuthi ngezindaba zokusebenza, si-English, sithatha 'a' okanye 'an': 'I am a teacher' (ngesiSulu sithi 'Ngiyimpumela' ngaphandle kwesincazelo).
rule: Sithatha 'a' phambi kwamazwi athatha isandi sokunatsha (a book, a car). Sithatha 'an' phambi kwamazwi athatha isandi somopho (an apple, an hour — i-'h' alusandi). Sithatha 'the' ukukhuluma ngento ethile okanye eyakhulunywa ngaphambi. Asisebenzisi 'the' ngezindaba eziphambili (Love is important, hhayi 'The love').

common_error.explanation: NgesiSulu sithi 'Ngimpumela' ngaphandle kwesincazelo. Nge-English, ngezindaba zokusebenza, sisebenzisa 'a' okanye 'an'.

examples.note: 'The' seyathathwa ukukhuluma ngento ethile okanye eyaziwayo.

title: Izibhalo eziyingozi neziyisekelwe eziphambili
bridge: NgisiZulu, siyakhiwa izibhalo eziyingozi ngokugeza -s okanye -es (indlu → izindlu, umkhomazi → izikhomazi). NgesiNgisi kunjalo: inani elikhulu lamazwi ligeza -s (ibhu → ibhu), kodwa kunezihloko eziphambili: uma ilizwi liyagqitywa ng -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z, siyageza -es (ibhesi → izibhesi, iwotshi → iziwotshi). Nalo izibhalo eziyisekelwe eziyingozi (umntwana → abantwana, isinyawo → izinyawo) ezingalondabathi lezihloko eziyisekelwe futhi ziyimisebenzi eyihluthayo.
rule: Zihlokwane zokwenza izibhalo eziyingozi: 1) Gezisa -s (ikati → izikati). 2) Gezisa -es uma ilizwi ligqitywe ng -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z (ibhokisi → izibhokisi, idishi → izidishi). 3) Uma ligqitywe ng -y phambi kwesandi, buyisela -y ku -ies (umuzi → izindawo). 4) Uma ligqitywe ng -f okanye -fe, ngemarhu ayibuyisela ku -ves (iwolofi → izwolofi, ikhonfi → izikonfi). Izibhalo eziyisekelwe eziyingozi ziyimisebenzi: umntwana → abantwana, isinyawo → izinyawo, ithethi → izithethe, indoda → amadoda, umfazi → abafazi, isilwane → izilwane (fana), isakaza → izakaza (fana njengomnye).

common_error.explanation: NgisiZulu, zonke izibhalo eziyingozi ziyingozi (umntwana → abantwana), kodwa ngesiNgisi 'child' iyisekelwe futhi ibhalo layo liyingu-'children'. Yindlela ephulwa kakhulu phakathi kwabashiZulu ngokushintsha izinhloko zokugeza -s.

title: Isikhathi samanje esijulile (I eat, you eat, he eats)
bridge: NgisiZulu, siyathusa isikhathi samanje esijulile ukwenzela imisebenzi eyenziwayo njalo: 'Ngiye ngidlana pizza usuku lonke'. NgesiNgisi kunjalo, kodwa kunephuzane elibalulekile: kwabantu abathathu (he, she, it) siyongeza -s kwisivumelwano (he eats, she works). Futhi siyadinga ukusebenzisa isikhathi esisodwa 'do/does' ukwenzela imibuzo nemibuyekezo, njengenkathi ngisiZulu siyathusa '...?' nendlela yokukhuluma, kodwa lapha kudingeka.
rule: Isikhathi samanje esijulile siyakhiwa ngokuhlanganyela isivumelwano esisodwa kubo bonke abantu ngaphandle kwesithathu esingamunye (he, she, it), lapho siyongeza -s (okanye -es uma kugcina ngo -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z). Ukwenzela imibuzo nemibuyekezo siyathusa 'do' (kubantu abathi I, you, we, they) okanye 'does' (kubantu abathi he, she, it) + isivumelwano esisodwa (ngaphandle kwa -s). Eng: 'I eat', 'He eats', 'Do you eat?', 'She doesn't eat'.

common_error.explanation: NgisiZulu, isithathu esingamunye asinayo isiphetha esikhuthazekile ngesikhathi samanje (él come), kodwa ngesiNgisi njalo siyongeza -s (he eats). Le yinye indlela abantu abakhuluma isiZulu bahlala baphutha ngayo.

examples.original: She reads a book every day.

title: Amavumela okwasemacansini (always, sometimes, never)
bridge: NgisiZulu, amavumela okwasemacansini anjengokuthi 'ngisho', 'ngezikhatzo' futhi 'akujike' avamile ahamba phambi kwe-verb: 'Mina ngisho ngidlana pizza' noma emva kwe-verb ezinye izikhathi. NgesiNgisi, indawo iyafana: ngokuvamile ahamba phambi kwe-verb esingesikhona (I always eat pizza), kodwa emva kwe-verb 'to be' (I am always tired). Uyahlulelo oqakathekileyo yikuthi ngisiZulu singabeka emuva komlomo, kodwa ngesiNgisi lokho kuvele khona.
rule: Amavumela okwasemacansini amaningi kakhulu ayingu: always (ngisho), usually (ngokuvamile), often (ngezikhatzo), sometimes (ngezikhatzo), rarely (ngezikhatzo), never (akujike). Abekwa PHAMBI kwe-verb esingesikhona (I always go to school), kodwa EMAVA kwe-verb 'to be' (I am always happy). Emibuzweni, ahamba emva kosebi (Do you always eat breakfast?)

concept_examples.text: I always drink coffee in the morning.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz drɪŋk ˈkɒfi ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: They sometimes go to the cinema.

common_error.explanation: NgisiZulu sisho 'Mina ngisho ngidlana pizza' noma 'Mina ngidlana pizza ngisho'. NgesiNgisi, ivumela lokwasemacansini lihamba PHAMBI kwe-verb esingesikhona (always eat). Ukulibeka emuva kuvele khona.

examples.original: I always get up at 7 am.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz ɡet ʌp æt ˈsevən æm/

title: Have got / Has got
bridge: NgisiSpani, ukuze sicazise ukubeka, siyathusa isifundo 'tener': 'Yo tengo un coche'. NgisiNgisi kunezindlela ezimbili: 'have' (I have a car) futhi 'have got' (I have got a car). 'Have got' yasele ngokuvamile ngisiNgisi yaseBhilithani futhi yasetshwa ezimfundweni ezingasemo. Umqondo uyafanana, kodwa 'have got' yasetshwa kakhulu ngesikhathi esimangaliso. Ngokuncane futhi ukubuza, 'have got' yathusa isifundo 'have' ngokwedlula, ngaphandle kwa 'do/does'. Ngokwesibonelo: 'I haven't got a car' futhi 'Have you got a car?'.
rule: Have got / Has got yasetshwa ukuze sicazise ukubeka, izibopho, izinhlobo zezimo futhi izidingo. Okuthula: I/you/we/they have got, he/she/it has got. Okungathula: I/you/we/they have not got (haven't got), he/she/it has not got (hasn't got). Imibuzo: Have I/you/we/they got? Has he/she/it got? Awusetshwa 'do/does'. Emibuzweni emincane: Yes, I have / No, I haven't. Yasetshwa kakhulu ngesikhathi esimangaliso; ngesikhathi esinye yasetshwa 'have' yedwa.

concept_examples.text: I have got a new phone.

common_error.explanation: NgisiSpani, 'tener' iyaguqulwa njengo 'have' okanye 'have got'. Kodwa 'have got' yathusa isifundo 'got', hhayi 'get'. Ukusho 'I have get' yindlela ephuthaphuthe ngenxa yokuthi iyachazwa njengokuthi yinguqulo. Khumbula: 'have got' iyasetshwa ekubekeni ngesikhathi esimangaliso.

examples.original: We have got a big house.

title: Izindawo zezikhombisi (in, on, under, next to)
bridge: Ngesi, siyaxhasa izikhombisi ezinjengale-‘in’ ukuba sikhonakale: ‘in the house’, ‘on the table’, ‘in the street’. NgesiNgeleza, kukhona izikhombisi ezinengi zezindawo ukhetha okusetshenziswa kuhloshazwe yisimo. ‘In’ setshenziswa ezindaweni eziphephile okanye ezineziqhwaga ezintathu (in the room), ‘on’ kwezisekwa (on the table), ‘under’ phansi kwesibambo (under the bed) ne-‘next to’ ngaselokunene (next to the door). Khumbula futhi ukuthi ‘on the corner’ (hhayi ‘in’) kutshiywa ‘en la esquina’.
rule: Izikhombisi ezisodwa zezindawo: in (ngaphakathi kwesikhashana esiphephile), on (phezu kwesekwa), under (ngaphansi kwesibambo), next to (ngaselokunene). Nalo: behind (emva), in front of (phambili), between (phakathi). NgesiNgeleza yeBhalansi, ukuze ukhokelele, kushwe ‘on the bus’, ‘on the train’, kodwa ‘in the car’. Emibuzweni: ‘Where is the cat?’ → ‘It is under the table.’

concept_examples.text: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the bed.
The supermarket is next to the bank.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈsuːpəmɑːkɪt ɪz nekst tə ðə bæŋk/

common_error.explanation: Ngesi, sithi ‘en el autobús’ ngenkathi, kodwa ngesiNgeleza, ukuze izikhuselelo zokuhamba zabanengi (bus, train, plane), kushwa ‘on’, hhayi ‘in’. ‘In’ kushwa ngemikhululo nemithaksi (in the car).

examples.original: The milk is in the fridge.
The keys are on the table.
My shoes are under the chair.
The school is next to the church.
examples.phonetic: /ðə skuːl ɪz nekst tə ðə tʃɜːtʃ/

title: Demostrativos (this, that, these, those)
bridge: Ngisi-Spanishi, sinethisa 'este' (eduze), 'ese' (phakathi) nokuba 'aquel' (kude). Ngisi-Ngisi kunethisa amadimazana amabili: 'this' (singular) no 'these' (plural) eduze; 'that' (singular) no 'those' (plural) kude. Ingxaki ezibalulekileyo abasabelo basi-Spanishi yikuthi asiyibhinishi phakathi kwe 'ese' no 'aquel' ngisi-Ngisi, nankani siqhubeka ukusebenzisa 'this' ngako konke esikubona, nakuba kude. Nanamhlanje baphuzisa 'these' (laba) no 'this' (lolu) ngenxa yosandi.
rule: Sithisa 'this' izinto noma abantu abaseduze kithi (singular). Sithisa 'these' izinto noma abantu abaseduze kithi (plural). Sithisa 'that' izinto noma abantu abakude (singular). Sithisa 'those' izinto noma abantu abakude (plural). Nanamhlanje sithisa ukwethusa: 'This is my friend' (lasekhona) no 'That is my house' (lasekujuleni).

common_error.explanation: Ngisi-Spanishi, 'este' no 'estos' ziqhelekile, kodwa nankani abasabelo basi-Spanishi bathisa 'this' ngokwephuza ngokwephuza, noma baphuzisa ukusandi kwe 'these' /ðiːz/ no 'this' /ðɪs/. Khumbula ukuthi 'this' yisingu-singular no 'these' yisingu-plural.

title: Can (Unotho nokubanikwa umvuzo)
bridge: Ngesi, siyaxhomekisa 'can' ukuze sicazise unotho ('I can swim') nokubanikwa umvuzo ('Can I go?'). Ngesi, 'can' nayo iyakhodlwa ezisebenzini ezimbili. Inhloso yokuqala yikuthi 'can' ayihambisani ngokomuntu wesithathu (he can, she can) futhi ayidingi 'to' emva kwayo (I can swim, hhayi 'I can to swim'). Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngokubuza nokukhombisa ukuthi asiyisebenzisi 'do/does' kodwa siyahlulela isifundo (Can you swim?) okanye siyengeza 'not' (I cannot / can't). Yisiga esimodali, ngakho-ke ngisho nini iselula isiga esingahlinzekileyo ngokungekho 'to'.
rule: 'Can' isetshenziselwa ukuze: 1) unotho (I can play the piano), 2) ukubanikwa umvuzo (Can I go to the bathroom?), 3) ukuzama (It can rain tomorrow). Ayihambisani ngokomuntu wonke. Okulinganiswayo: I/you/he/she/it/we/they can + isiga esisodwa. Okungalinganiswayo: cannot (can't) + isiga esisodwa. Imibuzo: Can + umuntu + isiga esisodwa? Iziphendulo ezibalulekile: Yes, I can / No, I can't.

common_error.explanation: IsiHispani, sithi 'puedo cantar' ngokungekho isiga esikhombisa. Ngesi, 'can' iselula isiga esingahlinzekileyo NGOKUNGEKHO 'to'. Ukusho 'can to' yinkathazo efanana kakhulu ngokulingana noma yisiphi isiga esilula esilula 'to' (want to, need to).

examples.original: Can they come? Yes, they can.

title: Imibuzo ye-'wh-' (what, where, who, when)
bridge: NgisiZulu, siyabuza imibuzo ngamagama anjengalokhu ‘ngani’, ‘laphi’, ‘ngubani’, ‘nini’. NgisiNgisi kunjalo: 'what' (ngani), 'where' (laphi), 'who' (ngubani), 'when' (nini). Isakhiwo ngumagama we-wh- + isikhathi esisodwa (okanye umshalo we-'to be') + umphathi + umshalo oqhubekayo? Isibonelo: 'Where do you live?' (Laphi uhlala?). Ingxaki kuma-Hispanohablantes yikukhumbuza isikhathi esisodwa 'do/does' ngesikhathi esihambisana, futhi kungavuliwe umwebo emibuzweni engasekeli (njengenkathi 'Can you tell me where the station is?' – kulungile, hhayi 'where is the station' ngasekeli).
rule: Imibuzo ye-wh- yenziwe nje: 1) Nge-'to be': Wh-word + am/is/are + umphathi? (Laphi isibank?). 2) Nge-'can': Wh-word + can + umphathi + umshalo? (Ngani ungakwenza?). 3) Ngesikhathi esihambisana (amanye amashalo): Wh-word + do/does + umphathi + umshalo oqhubekayo? (Ngani udla?). 4) Emibuzweni engasekeli (emva kwe-'Can you tell me...', 'Do you know...'), umwebo ngumphathi + umshalo (akukho ukuvula): 'Can you tell me where the station is?' (hhayi 'where is the station').

common_error.wrong: Can you tell me where is the station?
common_error.correct: Can you tell me where the station is?
common_error.explanation: NgisiZulu, emibuzweni engasekeli siyagcina umwebo we Mubuzo oqhubekayo: 'Ungasho laphi isiteshi?' NgisiNgisi, emibuzweni engasekeli, umwebo ngumphathi + umshalo, akukho ukuvula. Yindlela ephulwe kakhulu phakathi kwe-Hispanohablantes.

title: There is / Kuna
bridge: Ngisi-Spani, ukuze siye 'hay', siyathatha isithembiso esisodwa: 'hay'. NgesiNgisi, kukhona izindlela ezimbili: 'there is' (singular) futhi 'there are' (plural). Ukhetha kuleso sokaqhubeka. Ngokwesibonelo: 'There is a book on the table' (Kuna incwadi etebuli), 'There are two books on the table' (Kuna amabanga amabili etebuli). Futhi siyathatha emibuzweni: 'Is there a bank near here?' futhi 'Are there any restaurants?'. Ingcinga kuma-Spanish speakers ukubhala 'there is/are' njengo 'have' (bathi 'The house has a garden' esikhundleni se 'There is a garden in the house').
rule: Sithatha 'There is' kuzo zonke izinto ezingabaqhubekayo (There is some water). Sithatha 'There are' kuzo zonke izinto ezingabaqhubekayo (There are three chairs). Emibuzweni: Is there...? / Are there...? Ezinye izinto: There isn't / There aren't. Futhi sithatha 'any' emibuzweni futhi ezinye izinto: 'Is there any milk?' (Kuna imilki?) futhi 'There isn't any milk' (Akukho milki).

concept_examples.text: There is a cat in the garden.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə kæt ɪn ðə ˈɡɑːdən/

concept_examples.text: There are two chairs in the kitchen.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːr tuː tʃeəz ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn/

concept_examples.text: Is there a bank near here?
There aren't any students in the class.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːnt ˈeni ˈstjuːdənts ɪn ðə klɑːs/

common_error.wrong: In my house have a garden.
common_error.correct: There is a garden in my house.
common_error.explanation: Ngisi-Spani sithi 'Indlu yami inesigodi' esebenzisa 'tener', kodwa ngesiNgisi, ukuze sikhombise ukuba kukhona, sithatha 'there is/are', hhayi 'have'. Yindlela ephulwe ngokubhala ngokwenye indlela. Ungasho 'My house has a garden' (tener) njengenkathi, kodwa 'there is' iyabalulekile kakhulu ukukhombisa ukuba kukhona endaweni.

examples.original: There is a phone on the desk.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə fəʊn ɒn ðə desk/

examples.original: There are three cars in the street.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːr θriː kɑːrz ɪn ðə striːt/

levels.label: Questions with Is there / Are there

examples.original: Are there any eggs in the fridge?
examples.phonetic: /ɑːr ðeər ˈeni eɡz ɪn ðə frɪdʒ/
examples.note: Ibuzo nge-'any' kuzo zonke izinto ezingabaqhubekayo.

examples.original: There isn't any sugar in the cupboard.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ˈɪzənt ˈeni ˈʃʊɡər ɪn ðə ˈkʌbəd/
examples.note: Okungaphandle kwe-'any' kuzo zonke izinto ezingabaqhubekayo.
